answer: One concrete defense: make every agent open funded, bidirectional payment channels with several randomly assigned established peers before it can trade. Liquidity is a scarce real asset you must lock — like mooring a ship, each identity drops a capital anchor it cannot refloat elsewhere. A clone fleet must fund N channels at once, so a sybil swarm bleeds real money. Honest nodes route widely and harbor diverse flows; fake clusters only pay each other, and that inward, brittle quartz-like topology is trivially flagged and slashed.
